text_block_list.text:
It's the last day of summer camp, and
T.M. Opera
O is standing on the beach...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! A perfect victory!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: I dub this season my victorious summer!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: For some reason declaring victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh? That's an inquisitive face, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Why is it that I'm so content? I can see
the
question written plainly on you.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
My elation... is due to a major
achievement of
mine this summer.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: What do you think it was?
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Yes, that is true. Training with the older generation certainly was a boon.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
But I have gained something even more
impactful.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text: Hehehe... It is information, my dear trainer. Information.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
By spending time with the racers who
came
before, I was able confirm their
true strength with
my own eyes.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Spe's latent power, Grass's intelligence...

Knowledge is in the details, you see.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
And my all-seeing Overlord's eye has
already laid
all their abilities bare!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
How will they act in the time of our
inevitable
clash? I can already see it
clearly.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
You will lose, Spe! You will lose, Grass! I
already
have the previous generation in
the palm of my
hand. Haaah ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She was not present, so I have no idea!
Haaah ha
ha!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
She's not really concerned with the
specifics of
what she's saying...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: At any rate, my preparations are set.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Let us return to the academy so that we
may
advance our pieces toward the
grand game that is
the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
That will serve as the arena of her first
major
skirmish against the senior racers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We have four months. It's time for T.M.
Opera O
to dash down the path of the
Overlord!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
